notes.title: Answers the Questions (Part 2)
notes.content:
[b]1.Is this mutliplayer update only for online multiplayer or LAN?[/b]
[i]Multiplayer system of the game will be working only for LAN.[/i]

[b][i]Edit:[/i][/b]
[i]For play in multiplayer mode you can also use popular programs for that. 
(Tunngle, Hamachi)[/i]

[b]2. How many people can play simultaneously on the same server?[/b]
[i]Now we are testing multiplayer for 4 players.[/i]

[b]3.When multiplayer will be added?[/b]
[i]Multiplayer mode will be added for free in the nearest time.[/i]

[b]4. How does multiplayer works?[/b]
[i]When you start multiplayer game (4 players max), you will need to select a player type(Hunter or Rake), only one player can play Rake, others players will be play Hunter. The main objective at hunters is kill Rake. Objective of the Rake is kill all Hunters. The game will have over when all Hunters was dead or Rake was killed.[/i]

[b]If you have some questions about the game please write below your question and i will answer on it in the next post[/b]
